description: Uploads a file and asks the server to auto-map columns to the target entity. Set dryRun=true to get the proposed mapping back without creating an import — useful for showing the user what will happen and asking 'does this look right?' before committing. Set dryRun=false (default) to auto-map and import in one call.

dryRun.description: If true, returns proposed mapping without starting an import. Default false.

entityName.description: Entity to import as — must match list_entities output.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a .csv, .xlsx, or .xls file.

name: auto_import

outputSchema.description: Either an import object (dryRun=false) or a proposed mapping with detected columns (dryRun=true).

detectedColumns.description: Headers found in the uploaded file (present when dryRun=true).

missingRequired.description: Required target fields the auto-mapper could not resolve.
